name: Rohan Verma
bio: Rohan's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for rally racing in the Himalayas, fueling a desire to understand the intricate logistics behind successful teams. He honed his skills through a degree in supply chain management and several internships with Indian racing teams, focusing on optimizing parts delivery and equipment transportation. He approaches logistics with a systematic and adaptable mindset, thriving under pressure and quickly adapting to unforeseen challenges. Rohan's experience in diverse motorsport environments sets him apart, offering a unique perspective on efficiency and resource management.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly parted on the left
physical.description: Rohan is of average height with a focused expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down ideas and track shipments
Meticulously color-codes his spreadsheets and documents
